---
title: "Lesson 1: Vectors and Spaces"
---

## Overview

A vector space is a collection of objects that can be added together and scaled.

## Intuition

Vectors are like arrows, but the abstract viewpoint lets us study many different kinds of objects at once.

## Formal Definition

A vector space $V$ over a field $F$ is closed under addition and scalar multiplication.

$$
 u + v \in V, \quad \lambda u \in V
$$

## Examples

- $
\mathbb{R}^2$
- The space of polynomials
- The space of continuous functions
